name: Web Domains (Firebase Hosting custom domains + DNS)
description: Connect a custom domain to a Firebase Hosting site: register via the Hosting customDomains REST API, report the exact DNS records the operator must add (provider-agnostic), then verify.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When a website surface needs a custom domain (apex or subdomain) pointed at its Firebase Hosting site — to determine exactly which DNS records to hand the operator/DNS admin, apply them, and verify the domain goes live over HTTPS.
